 [![](https://www.mspca.org/app/uploads/2025/05/6.png) Referring Veterinarians](https://www.cognitoforms.com/AngellAnimalMedicalCenter/AngellAnimalMedicalCenterReferralForm)

## Our Approach

Your pet’s health and happiness have always been our top priority here at the MSPCA-Angell. Now, you can enjoy a brand-new service: professional pet grooming at our Boston location.

Whether your cat or dog needs a spa-day bath or a stylish trim, our pet grooming services in Boston keep your furry friend looking fresh, feeling comfortable, and smelling their best.

### Why Choose the MSPCA-Angell for Pet Grooming in Boston?

*   **Trusted veterinary care and grooming.** You already rely on the MSPCA-Angell for your pet’s health. Now you can trust us to keep them clean, comfortable, and confident.
*   **Safe, stress-free environment.** Our grooming salon is located in our Healthy Boarding ward, an exclusive area separate from our Medical wards.
*   **Expert groomer you can trust.** Our talented groomer, Charlotte Gale, is Fear-Free Certified and dedicated to creating a stress-free, gentle environment where your pet’s comfort comes first.
*   **Trusted veterinary medical care nearby.** Should your pet require extra support, the MSPCA-Angell’s veterinary staff is steps away.

## Our Services

From skin and coat health to calming techniques and customized care, our Fear-Free Certified pet groomer works with you and your pet to make each visit a positive experience. Never rushed, and always kind!

Our services for dogs and cats include:

*   Full-service pet bathing
*   Partial and full haircuts for dogs and cats
*   Deshedding treatments
*   Toothbrushing
*   Nail trimming
*   Ear cleaning
*   Bathing and grooming options offered during boarding stays for your convenience
*   Hypoallergenic shampoos for fragrance sensitivities
*   Lots of patience and TLC
*   And more!

![](https://www.mspca.org/app/uploads/2025/05/TeamBlock2.png)

## Requirements for Grooming Services

To keep everyone safe and healthy, our pet grooming services are available to:

*   **Established MSPCA-Angell clients**. Our grooming services are available to dogs and cats that have established care with one of our non-emergency veterinarians within the past year.
*   **Pets must be current on vaccines**.  
    **–** Dogs — Rabies and DHPP (puppies under 16 weeks old must be up to date on all vaccines based on age requirement)  
    **–** Cats — Rabies and FVRCP
*   **All pets must be able to stand** for the full length of a grooming appointment (approximately 2 hours).

If you have questions or concerns about whether your pet qualifies, please reach out to us for more details.

We look forward to your pet’s next spa day!
